entities.summary: Ramaz Nikolaishvili is a Georgian politician who has served as Governor of Guria and Deputy Minister of Defense in 2008, Chairman of the Roads Department in 2008–2010, Minister of Infrastructure and Regional Development in 2010-2012, and Member of Parliament 2012-2025.
